description: Applies one of twenty-one mathematical functions to a voltage, naming the chosen one on the display

params.text: Steps back through the list of functions
Steps forward through the list of functions

inputs.text: The voltage the function is applied to

outputs.text: The result of the function applied to the input voltage

notes: the functions in order are abs, round, ceil, floor, pow2, sqrt, exp, log, log10, cos, sin, tan, acos, asin, atan, cosh, sinh, tanh, acosh, asinh and atanh
the red lamps light when the chosen function has no finite answer for the voltage at the input, such as the square root of a negative one
